_note: This file is the ONLY thing that grants NMRx permission to touch a remote host.
The 50-entry source registry is a RESEARCH DIRECTORY. Presence in the registry grants nothing.
A host is reachable by NMRx only if it appears in allowed_hosts here AND is allowed by the
Claude Code cloud environment's own 'Allowed domains' network setting. Those are two separate
gates and this file cannot open the second one.

pilot.name: NMRx small pilot
pilot.provenance: Hostnames taken from the NMRx chemical database map, section 'Domains for the current pilot and future expansion'.

allowed_hosts.hostname_caution: BindingDB documentation also uses bindingdb.org (no www) and the download alias ww.bindingdb.org. Those are DIFFERENT hostnames and are NOT granted here.

caps._why: No numeric byte or request cap was recorded in the handoff material. These conservative defaults are enforced now so the pilot cannot silently become a bulk download. Raise them only on an explicit instruction.

candidate_expansion._note: Assessed, NOT granted. Needs an explicit user decision AND an environment network change before any request is made.

prohibited_hosts.reason: Provider disclaimer prohibits automated robot collection and large downloads. Manual reference only. Never add to allowed_hosts.
